sentences.text: Economic Help To Tribal Girls For Higher Education (Class 11 & 12)
**Scheme Brief Description:** Rajasthan Government started a scholarship for tribal girls higher education (Class 11 & 12) In the year 2011.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Social welfare & Empowerment; Sector: Financial assistance

**Detailed Description:** Rajasthan state government started a scheme "**Economic Help to Tribal Girls for Higher Education (Class 11 & 12)**". The main objective is to provide benefits to the tribal girls for their higher education, who are studying in government schools by taking admission as regular students for higher education.
**Benefits / Assistance:** - Rs. 3,500/- One time and fully in July

**Application Process:** 1. Applicant to log in to [RajSSO](https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in) Portal using his/her SSOID.1. If SSOID is not available then the applicant to first [register ](https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/register)on RajSSO Portal to create SSOID and update SSO Profile at first login.1. After successful authentication/login and updation of the SSOID Profile and select the scheme name. 1. Select his/her name, the bank account and fill in personal details. 1. Upload the required document. 1. Click the “SUBMIT” button.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Tribal Area Development Department
**Tags:** Financial Assistance, Educational Grant, Student, Higher Education
